question: Kiran got married 20 years ago. Today Kiran's age is frac{{11}}{7} times of his age at the time of his marriage. What will Kiran's age be ten years from now?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of Present Age to Marriage Age = 11 : 7 Difference in ratio = 11 − 7 = 4 units. Since he got married 20 years ago, 4 units = 20 years → 1 unit = 5 years. Present Age = 11 units = 11 × 5 = 55 years. Kiran's age 10 years from now = 55 + 10 = 65 years. **∴ The correct answer is 65 years.**
